feed_summary: The North Korea-linked Lazarus Group has been attributed to a cyber espionage campaign dubbed Operation FlashHole targeting at least three organizations in South Korea spanning the construction, software, and wire-communication equipment manufacturing sectors. title: Lazarus Abuses South Korean Security Software to Deploy Malware Using Post-Quantum Encryption
